## Work Experience

### Fourth Frontier Technologies — Backend Software Developer Intern
May 2026 – Present. Bangalore, on-site.

- Engineered an end-to-end, multi-platform subscription management system in a
  fast-paced startup environment, handling cross-platform purchases via Shopify
  Webhooks and Android In-App APIs. Designed dynamic data-mapping logic and
  custom validation middleware to classify users across a 4-tier subscription
  model, with event-driven Slack API integrations and cron jobs for automated
  team alerts and subscription lifecycle management.
- Refactored workout storage for 20 physiological metrics per timestamp,
  reducing database records from 20 to 1 per timestamp through a new data model.
  Architected versioned serverless APIs on AWS Lambda with a 2-tier fallback
  mechanism and Amazon S3 integration, including the v12 Create Workout and
  View Workout APIs.
- Eliminated UI lag in acceleration graphs by implementing the Largest Triangle
  Three Buckets (LTTB) algorithm, reducing 86K data points to 2K while
  preserving visual fidelity.
- Diagnosed production issues across AWS Lambda workflows by testing backend
  APIs with Postman, Jest/Supertest, and Lambda's built-in test functionality.
  Analyzed CloudWatch logs to identify API integration and event-processing
  failures.

### Tradylytics — Full Stack Developer Intern
May 2025 – July 2025. Remote. IIT Patna-backed startup.

  user sign-in while strengthening account security.

### AI Creator Copilot — Pocket FM Hackathon (1st Runner-Up)
Stack: FastAPI, LangGraph, Google Gemini, React.js, Zustand, Tailwind CSS.

- Developed an end-to-end AI Creator Studio that transforms a story idea into a

  to review, edit, and regenerate AI outputs before proceeding to the next stage.

  regenerate outputs at every stage while preserving workflow state across
  server restarts.

  episode generation.

  generation progress, and stage-wise approve/edit/regenerate controls.
